stage0093b_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... feels strange,
　meeting face to face like this.」

stage0093b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Will you lend us your strength?」

stage0093b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$アルト$$
「This guy...!
　Still saying that, even now...!」

stage0093b_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$宗介$$
「Wait, $$アルト$$.
　I'll deal with him.」

stage0093b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$n
「I'm used to handling wild beasts.
　Everyone else, stand back.」

stage0093b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$甲児$$
「Not a chance.
　I'll be the one to pay him back first.」

stage0093b_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$ミコノ$$'s put up with plenty from this guy.
　Leave this one to me.」

stage0093b_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Interesting!
　I'll take you all on at once!」

stage0093b_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$カグラ$$...
　Seems like people really resent you, huh?」

stage0093b_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Like I said already.
　I've got no intention of playing nice.」

stage0093b_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Then I think we should really get along.」

stage0093b_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$ユノハ$$'s right.
　Dragging on about the past
　forever isn't very manly, you know.」

stage0093b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Let's do this properly, $$カグラ$$.
　We're going to be comrades fighting together from now on.」

stage0093b_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I never said I'd become your comrade...」

stage0093b_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「...But still, I've got to thank you all
　for saving Altair.」

stage0093b_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Gloomy a place as it is,
　it's the planet I grew up on.」

stage0093b_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シュレード$$
「A straight, clear tone...
　So, this is your heart.」

stage0093b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Shut up!
　You who couldn't even die!」

stage0093b_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... I've overcome fate. Nothing scares me now.」

stage0093b_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ジン$$
「Me too.
　From now on, I'll fight alongside $$ユノハ$$
　to protect the world she loves.」

stage0093b_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ジン$$
「Not just for $$ユノハ$$'s sake.
　I've got a lot of friends here too.」

stage0093b_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$シンジ$$, all the Elements...
　And $$カグラ$$.」

stage0093b_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Tch... can't compete with a guy back from hell.」

stage0093b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ジン$$
「Good to have you, $$シンジ$$.
　We're in this together from now on.」

stage0093b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Good to have you aboard, $$カグラ$$.
　We'll be counting on your strength too.」

stage0093b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... don't go dragging me down, $$アマタ$$.」

stage0093b_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'm going to have to teach you
　some manners, thoroughly.」

stage0093b_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「More inverted talk?
　Then I guess I get to go all out.」

stage0093b_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Leave it to me, $$シルフィ$$.」

stage0093b_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's not it, is it, $$カグラ$$?」

stage0093b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Yeah.
　...Looking forward to working with you, $$ミコノ$$.」

stage0093b_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Well, looks like things between $$アマタ$$,
　that guy, and $$ミコノ$$ are settled.」

stage0093b_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$n
「I don't know exactly why, but I get
　how you feel... It's just timing now.」

stage0093b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$n
「They're not like that $$ミカゲ$$ guy.
　Too much consideration will only
　hurt them instead.」

stage0093b_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アルト$$
「...Never thought I'd get advice
　from you on this sort of thing.」

stage0093b_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$n
「...That wasn't like me.
　Forget I said it.」

stage0093b_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry about it.
　Once things settle down, tell me
　about Nurse.」

stage0093b_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$モロイ$$
「No... I don't see Supreme Commander $$不動$$ anywhere...」

stage0093b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Come to think of it...!」

stage0093b_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Don't you know anything, $$ＭＩＸ$$?
　Wasn't it Supreme Commander $$不動$$ who
　brought you to the alternate dimension?」

stage0093b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Honestly, I don't really understand it either.
　One moment I met Supreme Commander $$不動$$ on Altair,
　and the next I was already on the Quarter...」

stage0093b_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「So that means he... freely moved between
　Altair and the alternate dimension!?」

stage0093b_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whoa, whoa!
　Just who is that guy!?」

stage0093b_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$桂$$
「No need to worry.
　It's him we're talking about...
　He's surely doing his own thing somewhere.」

stage0093b_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「You sound like you know the Supreme Commander well.」

stage0093b_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Could it be, $$桂$$...
　Do you know the Supreme Commander's
　past life?」

stage0093b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$桂$$
（Too much of a spitting image
　to just call it a past life, though.）

stage0093b_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$クレア$$
「He's exactly what his name says he is...
　I'm sure even now, as always, he's watching
　over us... over humanity.」

stage0093b_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Chairwoman $$クレア$$, will you be taking
　the Supreme Commander's place on the battlefield?」

stage0093b_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$クレア$$
「My students are fighting with their lives on the line.
　As Chairwoman, I must set an example for them all.」

stage0093b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$桂$$
「Glad to have a cutie like you along.
　Nice to meet you, Chairwoman-chan.」

stage0093b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$クレア$$
「Even you, the ladies' man who's crossed
　time and space, can't guess my age, it seems.」

stage0093b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$クレア$$
「Let's leave that topic there.
　I'd rather not be pried into either.」

stage0093b_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Still, we... ever since we broke into Altair,
　we really haven't had a moment's rest from fighting.」

stage0093b_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$モーム$$
「That's true.
　And quite a lot of time's passed without us realizing it.」

stage0093b_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$桂$$
「Guess time really did get twisted up
　somewhere around that Paradigm City business.」

stage0093b_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's the only way to put it.」

stage0093b_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$桂$$
「So, you're saying that $$エンジェル$$
　was Paradigm City's very existence itself?」

stage0093b_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$
　speculated as much.」

stage0093b_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$デュオ$$
「A city's existence being one person...」

stage0093b_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I don't really understand it, but...」

stage0093b_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even she herself didn't understand
　why she was Paradigm City's memory.」

stage0093b_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But knowing the weight of her mission,
　the truth of their existence, and the future,
　she drove her own heart into isolation...」

stage0093b_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$トロワ$$
「So as a result, she tried to choose
　to forget everything, is that it?」

stage0093b_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$五飛$$
「That's a denial of the world...
　erasing Paradigm City itself...」

stage0093b_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$桂$$
「So that's the system this 'Taiji' thing prepared...」

stage0093b_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$カトル$$
「Thanks to Mr. $$ロジャー$$'s persuasion,
　she embraced the present and let go of the past.」

stage0093b_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That had me sweating for real.
　If Paradigm City had vanished like that,
　who knows what would've become of our world.」

stage0093b_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$カトル$$
「Next, it's our turn to break through
　the eternity we were made for...
　the Prison of Time.」

stage0093b_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But it seems $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　intends to decide humanity's future before that.」

stage0093b_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$桂$$
「Settle things before the $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　announcement, then seize control after...」

stage0093b_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$桂$$
「Unbelievable...
　With all that trouble waiting,
　and he still wants to be humanity's leader.」

stage0093b_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$トロワ$$
「That must be that man's resolve.」

stage0093b_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$五飛$$
「Not that I can accept something like that.」

stage0093b_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（$$シャア$$...
　the future you saw in the Zero System...
　is this battle the answer to that...）

stage0093b_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That your Big Bang
　came back!」

stage0093b_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ジン$$
「Still as lively as ever here, huh.」

stage0093b_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... quite the bloodbath,
　those two.」

stage0093b_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I can't quite tell if that's
　inverted talk or if he means it...!」

stage0093b_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, Master $$ゼシカ$$.
　Isn't it wonderful Master $$ＭＩＸ$$
　is back to normal?」

stage0093b_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Personally, I'm very glad Master
　$$ゼシカ$$ is back to normal too, though.」

stage0093b_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$アンディ$$ and Master $$ＭＩＸ$$, Master $$ゼシカ$$ and Master $$カグラ$$...
　Your two pairs' perfectly synced attacks
　produced 100 Z-Chips.」

stage0093b_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0093b_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Right, $$ＭＩＸ$$?
　Even $$ＡＧ$$ says we're the best combo.」

stage0093b_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「That doesn't excuse that tactless
　remark from before!」

stage0093b_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't be so angry, Master $$ＭＩＸ$$.
　After all, Master $$ＭＩＸ$$ is a goddess.」

stage0093b_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The power of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, the embodiment of a black hole,
　was truly something worthy of being called divine.」

stage0093b_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Likewise, Master $$ＭＩＸ$$, holder of
　the Big Bang, a mystery of the universe, is...」

stage0093b_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「You, of all people!
　It's been ages and this is
　sexual harassment?!」

stage0093b_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$.
　I've heard about you from $$甲児$$.」

stage0093b_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Could it be that you are...」

stage0093b_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$ゼウス$$...
　You may have once been a god of Olympus,
　but right now, you are a new recruit of $c.」

stage0093b_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wouldn't exposing a senior's privacy
　be a bit lacking in tact, don't you think?」

stage0093b_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「So that I may remain in this world even a moment longer,
　I will rest in the hangar except in times of battle.」

stage0093b_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Eh...!
　You mean to squat there with that huge body!?」

stage0093b_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no!
　I didn't say anything about flat feet!」

stage0093b_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Never mind...
　I have no intention of interfering needlessly.
　I believe humanity will carve out its future by its own strength.」

stage0093b_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Then, until the time for battle comes again,
　allow me to rest.」

stage0093b_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What were you doing in Paradigm City?」

stage0093b_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$スズネ$$
「While we were fighting,
　I heard from $$アストナージ$$ and $$チェーン$$
　that you'd gone out, Mr. $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0093b_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Were you perhaps chasing after Geminis?」

stage0093b_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well, if I've been found out, so be it.
　I too want to know the truth behind
　$$ガドライト$$'s $$ジェミニア$$ and $$ジェニオン$$'s resemblance.」

stage0093b_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No... I couldn't find Geminis,
　and more than that, I had my hands full
　just escaping that $$ビッグヴィヌス$$.」

stage0093b_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard from $n
　that you and the others met $$ガドライト$$.」

stage0093b_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I heard Miss $$アンナロッタ$$ said that man
　and $n look alike, and...
　I thought the same thing, too...」

stage0093b_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't put it well, but...
　I think he's carrying something inside too.」

stage0093b_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Geminis's circumstances mean nothing to me.
　They're scum who started a war on Earth
　through cowardly means.」

stage0093b_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And that's not all.
　For $n, they're the enemy who took his family.」

stage0093b_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you carelessly show sympathy to those guys,
　it'll be you and $n who end up dead.」

stage0093b_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You're right...
　It's just as you say...」

stage0093b_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As long as you understand, that's fine.
　I'm always praying for the safety
　of $n and you, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0093b_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's shift gears and go with a bang!
　Let's give it our all today too!」

stage0093b_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（That's right, Miss $$スズネ$$...
　$$ジェニオン$$ has to defeat $$ジェミニア$$.）
